description: Search Copart auction lots by keyword, make, model, damage, title, location and more — or paste a Copart search or lot URL. No login, cookies or proxy setup needed.

auctionName.description: Auction host name, for example NJ - GLASSBORO WEST or a specialty sale name.
auctionName.title: Auction name

bodyStyle.description: Only lots with this body style. Common US styles are mapped to UK equivalents; body style is US and UK only.
bodyStyle.title: Body style

buyItNowOnly.description: Only lots that have a Buy It Now price.
buyItNowOnly.title: Buy It Now only

cylinders.description: Only lots with this cylinder count. Available on the US and UK sites.
cylinders.title: Cylinders

damageType.description: Only lots with this primary damage type.
damageType.title: Primary damage

driveType.description: Only lots with this drive train. UK maps all-wheel drive to 4x4; front and rear wheel drive are US-only.
driveType.title: Drive train

fuelType.description: Only lots with this fuel type. Gas is matched as Petrol on the UK and Middle East sites.
fuelType.title: Fuel type

includeDetails.description: For search results, fetch each lot's full detail page and condition report. This adds one request per lot.
includeDetails.title: Include full details

includeImages.description: Fetch the full photo gallery for lots in Details mode, or for search results when Include full details is on.
includeImages.title: Include photo gallery

location.description: Copart yard name, for example NJ - GLASSBORO WEST.
location.title: Yard

lotNumbers.description: Lot numbers or Copart lot URLs to fetch in Details mode. Duplicates are removed.
lotNumbers.title: Lot numbers or lot URLs

make.description: Vehicle make as Copart lists it, for example BMW or TOYOTA.
make.sectionDescription: All filters are optional and combine with the keyword or URL.
make.title: Make

maxItems.description: Maximum number of lot records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: Choose Search to find lots, or Details to fetch specific lot numbers or lot URLs.
mode.sectionDescription: Use a Copart search URL, a keyword, or the filters below. A lot URL automatically switches to Details mode.
mode.title: Mode

model.description: Vehicle model, for example X7 or CAMRY.
model.title: Model

newlyAddedDays.description: Only lots added to Copart in the selected window.
newlyAddedDays.title: Newly added

searchQuery.description: Free-text keyword such as BMW, Toyota Camry, or a lot number. Leave empty to browse all vehicles.
searchQuery.title: Keyword

searchUrl.description: A Copart search results URL, for example https://www.copart.com/lotSearchResults?free=true&query=BMW. Filters you set on Copart are preserved. A /lot/<number> URL fetches that single lot.
searchUrl.title: Copart search URL

site.description: Country site used for keyword searches. A pasted URL overrides this setting.
site.title: Copart site

sort.sectionDescription: Control how many lots are collected and how much detail is added to each record.
sort.title: Sort by

titleType.description: Only lots with this title group. UK and Middle East sites map each option to their closest local category.
titleType.title: Title type

transmission.description: Only lots with this transmission. UK and Middle East sites match automatic and manual labels.
transmission.title: Transmission

vehicleType.description: Only automobiles, motorcycles or SUVs. SUV is available on the US site only.
vehicleType.title: Vehicle type

title: Copart Auction Lot Finder Input
